# Athlete History (SAMPLE: generated by core_progress_tracker.py from Garmin)

In the private deployment this file is regenerated weekly from the athlete's full Garmin
history; the coach reads it before calling any run a milestone, setting a pace, or judging
progress. The numbers below are illustrative.

## 1. Milestone ledger

| Distance | Runs | First | Most recent | Longest |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Half marathon+ (21.1 km) | 19 | 2025-09-28 | 2025-12-14 | 30.4 km |
| 25 km+ | 6 | 2025-10-05 | 2025-11-30 | 30.4 km |
| 30 km+ | 2 | 2025-10-26 | 2025-11-30 | 30.4 km |
| 32 km+ | 0 | never | never | not yet: this would be a real milestone |

## 2. Capacity vs. current readiness
- **Lifetime longest:** 30.4 km. Distances up to here are not milestones.
- **Longest in the last 30 days:** 21.4 km; single-run 10% cap today: **23.5 km** (P8).

## 3. Current fitness (last 4 weeks)
- **Pace at 150 bpm:** outdoor 5:20/km | treadmill 5:15/km.
- **Weekly km:** 45 (3 weeks) | 43 (11 weeks).

## 5. Plateau check (last 6 weeks vs. the 6 before)
| Trend | Prior 6 wk | Last 6 wk | Change | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Weekly km | 43.6 km | 44.5 km | +2.1% | plateau |
| Pace at 150 bpm (outdoor) | 5:36/km | 5:22/km | +4.1% | improving |
| VO2max | 56.8 | 58.2 | +1.4 | improving |
